create_llava_onevision_model: create a LlavaOnevisionForConditionalGeneration model from config for multimodal image and video understanding
run_llava_onevision_generation: run the LlavaOnevisionForConditionalGeneration model to generate text responses from image and text inputs
get_image_features: get image features from the vision tower and apply multimodal projection for the LlavaOnevision model
get_video_features: get video features from the vision tower, apply multimodal projection and pooling for the LlavaOnevision model
pack_image_features: pack image features by reshaping, unpading and concatenating visual vectors into a single tensor
